SENSEX JUMPS 989 POINTS TO 83,021 AS NIFTY HITS 25,514

On 19 November 2026 the BSE Sensex climbed 989.94 points to 83,021.75 and the NSE Nifty 50 rose 286.35 points to 25,514.30.
The rise reflects a broad‑based rally led by auto stocks, with mid‑cap and small‑cap indices also posting gains, indicating investor confidence despite regional sell‑offs.
